templateRegisterStep: Choose Register template on the saved page's row. The native settings form links the new provider to that template; verify Template to use before saving.
templateScopeStep: Set both Visibility Restrictions and Creation Restrictions to Drafts, leave Creation Restrictions as Suggestions unchecked, and keep Action on create set to Edit. Editors can then choose it when creating a draft.

guideContent:
Editors can edit content and attachments across Knowledge and Drafts, including home and category pages. In Knowledge, choose Edit content to open the linked draft. Save draft and preview, check the rendered page, then Submit for review. The published page changes only after approval. The submitter can withdraw a pending request. Reviewers approve and publish or return it for changes; the submitter cannot review their own work. Published working copies stay hidden until editing resumes. Editors can update the writing-area home directly. Administrators manage category definitions, permissions, users and system configuration.

For draw.io diagrams, use File → Export as → URL or File → Publish → Link in draw.io. In the draft editor, paste the link in External link — auto detect and select Insert link. Save and preview, then choose Preview diagram next to the link. Readers can also open the original link in a new tab. Private storage links may require sign-in and open through the original link instead of an inline preview.

Images and files: upload or import them as attachments of the article. In the editor, use Insert attachment to select an image, video or file. Upload / manage attachments opens a separate tab; refresh the list after upload. Images display in the article. PDF links use the browser viewer when available. Word, Excel and other files open the attachment page and provide a direct download link. Save and preview before submitting for review.

External links: GitHub, Bitbucket and other code/web links open their original websites. The same Insert link control accepts them. Existing imported link text and styling are preserved; standalone web URLs can become clickable links. Only supported draw.io share links have an optional diagram preview. Code-host links do not embed code or repository content.
uploadInvalid: Enter an integer from 1 to 99999 MB.
aboutContent:
LuxPedia is a private knowledge platform for finding, maintaining and sharing team knowledge. AI retrieval and online Office editing are not yet connected.

The wiki uses XWiki Standard 17.10.15 LTS (LGPL 2.1 or later), PostgreSQL 16.15 (PostgreSQL License) and Publication Workflow 2.4.9. The difference between the workflow extension’s published license metadata and repository wording is documented in docs/components.md and docs/workflow.md.

LuxPedia is the name of this instance. Upstream source files, NOTICE and LICENSE files, component identifiers and administration interfaces retain their original notices. Copyright remains with the respective rights holders. Branding does not change licensing or authorization checks.

componentGuideText:
== Insert and reuse ==

Open an article draft in the visual editor. Use **Content components** above the editor to insert a date, task checklist or decision overview. Each insert creates an independent copy in the article; later edits follow the same save, preview and review flow as other text.

* **Date:** choose a calendar date and label, such as effective date or review date. The saved date stays fixed.
* **Task checklist:** enter one task per line with an optional common owner and due date. Put the cursor in a task and choose **Toggle task completion** to switch between ☐ and ☑. Published/view pages do not change task state.
* **Decision overview:** enter the date, decision/rationale, owner and decision state. The inserted table can be extended with the native table editor.

== Browse and export ==

Open [[Page browser>>LuxPedia.Help.PageBrowser]] from the document library. Combine metadata filters, sort and paginate the accessible article list. Ordinary article tables have their own search, sort, page-size and Excel/CSV buttons. Export includes every row matching the current filters, across all pages.

Excel downloads are .xlsx workbooks; CSV uses UTF-8. Exports contain table values and merged-cell structure. Merged tables export in full and keep their original display; their filtering and sorting controls are disabled. Images, attachments, formulas and spreadsheet formatting are not embedded. Excel attachments continue to use the existing file/download flow.

Readers can browse and export what they can read. Inserting and changing components requires article editing rights and the current draft editing lease.

adminToolsIntro: Use the existing wiki administration to review roles, activity, runtime and page recovery.

adminConflict: A page changed, is occupied/in review, or the destination already exists. Refresh and review the selection again.

adminRuntimeHint: These are application checks and a current JVM/storage snapshot. Container and backup monitoring require separate integrations and are shown explicitly when unavailable.

adminPreviewHint: Review this exact selection. Confirmation expires in five minutes and can be used once. Restoring never overwrites an existing page. Restore the default language before its translations.

navDestinationHint: Enter a wiki reference such as Knowledge.WebHome, or an HTTP/HTTPS website. Leave empty for a menu group.
navRemoveChildren: Remove or reparent child entries first.
navEntryInvalid: Enter a label and select at least one visible role.
navUnsaved: Entry updated locally. Save configuration to publish the changes.
navPublishHint: Save configuration when finished. The nearest enabled category banner applies; the original site header/footer is preserved.
navFinishEntry: Keep or cancel the open entry before saving.
navSaved: Configuration saved. Refresh article pages to see the changes.
navSaveConflict: Settings changed or are invalid. Reload the configuration and check parent menus and categories before saving again.
navLanguageHint: Language changed; unsaved configuration is preserved. Native administration labels update after refresh.

qrLocalHint: This address is local to this computer. Use a server domain or LAN address for phone access.

departmentPublic: Public categories for signed-in site users
departmentCategoryHint: Checked categories include their descendants. No categories means no private category access. Departments never grant edit or review rights.
